notes.title: New Key Art, New Horrors on the Horizon
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43647529/8a925b7419a525e43435b77d52b354be2cd48bfe.jpg

Greetings,


We’re thrilled to share something special with you today: brand new key art for Tyrant’s Realm! This fresh visual identity was made possible with the support of an incredibly talented artist, and we couldn’t be happier with how it captures the atmosphere and essence of the game. It’s a bold new face for the project, and a small glimpse of what’s to come.

Speaking of what’s to come...

Our team has been hard at work behind the scenes crafting something new: an upcoming DLC for Tyrant’s Realm, scheduled for release in Late July. This new content expands the world in exciting ways—more places to explore, new dangers to face, and secrets better left untouched.

In June, we’ll begin unveiling what’s inside the DLC—expect a closer look at the new environments, gameplay mechanics, and the twisted narrative threads that weave this chapter into the larger fabric of Tyrant’s Realm. 

Thank you, as always, for your support—and for braving the Realm with us.

Until next time,
- The Tyrant’s Realm Team

notes.title: Tyrant's Realm – Free Content Update Now Live!
notes.content:
Greetings, warriors of the Realm!

A brand-new free content update has arrived in Tyrant’s Realm, bringing fresh challenges and rewards to those brave enough to face them. Whether you’re a seasoned fighter or a newcomer looking to sharpen your skills, this update has something for everyone. Here’s what’s new:

Master the Art of Boss Parrying

Test your reflexes against the fiercest foes! The long-requested Boss Parrying system is now live, giving you the power to counter and turn the tide of battle against even the deadliest adversaries. Precision and timing are key—perfect your parries and dominate the battlefield!

New Challenges for High Difficulty Modes

For those seeking an even greater test of skill, we’ve introduced new challenges for the highest difficulty levels. Sharpen your strategies, push your limits, and prove you have what it takes to conquer the Realm’s toughest trials.

24 New Challenge Chest Rewards & New Cosmetic Outfits

Complete the Challenges and unlock 24 brand-new rewards from Challenge Chests! These exclusive items will push you to complete objectives faster and more efficiently—only the most dedicated challengers will claim them all.

Additionally, the Challenge Chest now holds new cosmetic outfits, allowing you to customize your warrior’s look as you battle through the Realm. Earn them by completing challenges and stand out among your fellow champions.

Update Now and Prove Your Might!

This free update is available now—jump back into Tyrant’s Realm and test your skills against these new trials. Let us know what you think, and as always, we’ll see you in the fight!

Stay sharp, stay relentless, and rule the Realm!

notes.title: Tyrant’s Realm Update – Steam Deck Verified & More!
notes.content:
Adventurers, we have some exciting updates for you!

Steam Deck Verified!
Tyrant’s Realm is now officially Steam Deck Verified! This means you can take your adventure on the go with full support for controls, performance, and UI. Whether you’re battling through dungeons or strategizing for your next fight, you can now do it anywhere, anytime.

Steam Trading Cards Are Now Live!
The wait is over—Steam Trading Cards for Tyrant’s Realm have arrived! Start collecting cards as you play, trade with friends, and unlock exclusive badges, profile backgrounds, and emoticons to show off your Realm achievements. Who will be the first to collect them all?

Ongoing QoL Fixes & Future Content Updates
We’re committed to continuously improving your experience in Tyrant’s Realm. Expect minor quality-of-life improvements in upcoming patches to refine gameplay, enhance performance, and address player feedback. But that’s not all—we’re also shifting our focus towards larger content updates in the future. Stay tuned for new features, mechanics, and surprises as we continue expanding the world of Tyrant’s Realm!

Thank you for being part of this journey. Your support means everything, and we can't wait to share what’s next. Keep conquering, strategizing, and forging your legend!

notes.title: Thank You for Your Support! Updates and Improvements Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Hello, players of Tyrant’s Realm!

First off, we want to extend a huge thank you to everyone who has supported the game so far. Whether you’ve explored every corner of the realm, shared your thoughts, or left a review, your feedback and enthusiasm mean the world to us!

We’ve been hard at work behind the scenes to make Tyrant’s Realm the best experience it can be, and we’re excited to share a quick update on what’s coming next:

 -  Custom Key Bind Options
We know how important it is to tailor the controls to your playstyle. That’s why we’re working on a custom key binding feature! Soon, you’ll have the flexibility to map actions to your preferred keys or controller buttons.

 - Quality-of-Life Enhancements
You’ve shared some excellent suggestions to improve the overall experience, and we’ve been listening! From small tweaks to ease navigation to adjustments that streamline gameplay, these quality-of-life changes aim to make the game smoother and more enjoyable.

- Retroactive Achievement Fixes
We’ve heard feedback about achievements not unlocking retroactively for some players, and we’re addressing this issue! Once the update rolls out, your hard-earned progress will count toward those achievements, even if they didn’t trigger initially.

- And Many More Exciting Updates Coming Soon
This is just the beginning. We’re planning even more updates in the future to enhance your journey through Tyrant’s Realm. Stay tuned for announcements about additional features, fixes, and maybe even some surprises!

We Want to Hear from You!
Your feedback is what drives us. If you have suggestions, ideas, or just want to share your thoughts, feel free to drop a comment, write a review, or join us on Discord. Let’s continue shaping the realm together!

Thank you for being part of this adventure with us. We can’t wait to share these updates with you and see how you conquer the Tyrant’s Realm.

Stay retro,
— The Tyrant’s Realm Team
